scenarios.prompt: The same supplier sent INV-001 twice with different dates and totals. Preserve both values and show why review is needed.
scenarios.note: Two distinct candidate records in exact and normalized groups; Original dates and amounts preserved as explicit conflicting fields

scenarios.prompt: Find INV-001 versus inv /001 but keep INV-1 separate: leading zeros matter.
scenarios.note: Formatting change produces one two-record review group; Leading-zero difference excluded; All three original records retained

scenarios.prompt: These identical references belong to another entity, supplier, currency or a credit note. Do not merge them.
scenarios.note: Five source records retained; Zero candidate groups across distinct exact scopes; Zero means no candidates in supplied batch, not payment clearance

scenarios.prompt: Two different service invoices have the same amount and date. Show a weak review signal without calling either fraudulent.
scenarios.note: Only same_amount_date group emitted; No reference collision inferred; Two source records retained for human review

scenarios.prompt: Save a review with overlapping reasons, hit the free save cap, then export every source record without paying and remove the saved snapshots.
scenarios.note: Four candidate records counted once despite overlapping groups; Three saves succeed, fourth preserves full diagnosis with free_saved_report_cap; Complete four-row CSV and source paging remain free; Three created saved snapshots deleted and saved list returns zero

method: Fixed structured arguments and expected outcomes written before running actual MCP stdio. No model translation, real customers, client install timing, or competitor runtime.
score_definition: 3 only when every frozen expected-output and workflow assertion passes; 0 on any failure. An operator acceptance score, not subjective quality or customer preference.
bottom_line: Five specified synthetic buyer tasks returned the independently expected review evidence. No customer study, search visibility measurement, time saving estimate or revenue claim.
